messages:
sara: Quick update before we go live 10:00 start shifted: demo at 10:03, Q&A opens 10:16. Please watch #lobby for sticky.

trent-av: Noted. Doing one final AV pass. Saw caption provider handshake fail once in rehearsal, I'll warm-restart the caption service.

maria: Can we keep the demo on a single laptop to avoid slide-camera sync issues?

sara: Yes, we'll pin to one presenter. Leo you'll be primary slide controller.

trent-av: Caption-bot: reconnect attempt in 12s. If captions don't come up in 30s we fallback to post-meeting transcript.

caption-bot: Captions: service OK. Latency ~1.2s. Auto-correcting punctuation enabled.

maria: Thanks. If we hit audio jitter again, plan is to cut camera and continue slides only. I'll prep a short "audio fallback" slide.

trent-av: Good plan. Also: if OBS drops, auto-failover kicks in at 20s to backup ingest. Ops command is pinned in #eng-infra.

sara: For Q&A: we'll seed two leadership questions at open (roadmap priorities, Dedicated SLA timeline) and then open for upvotes. Maria and I will field the first 3 minutes.

leo: I'll pin the seeded prompts and monitor upvotes. If people DM questions, forward to #all-hands-qna.

trent-av: Final check: cameras green, audio -6dB, captions live. Switching to program in 30s. Good luck! :rocket:
